sourceRef: https://www.sars.gov.za/types-of-tax/unemployment-insurance-fund/ (read 2026-11-16); SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Guide for Employers iro Employees Tax 2027, Revision 1 p. 27
notes: A director of a private company drawing R10 000 remuneration. SARS UIF page lists who is excluded from contributing (under 24 h a month, national/provincial government, office bearers, municipal councillors, traditional leaders): directors are not on it, so UIF = 1% x 10 000 = 100.00 each side. G21 p. 27 says only that a director of a private company is an employee for employees tax. The UIC Act s1/s4 text was not read, so whether a director with no contract of service is an employee for UIF is not settled here. Only UIF is asserted.
